title: File:2021-es Spartathlon MAgyar Csapat rajtfotó.jpg
claims: The file shows the Hungarian Spartathlon team posing before the 2021 race start.
The file was taken on 24 September 2021.
Because of the pandemic, the 2021 race did not start at the Odeon of Herodes Atticus but a few hundred metres below it.
The author and uploader is Czajamatyas, credited as own work, and the file is licensed CC BY-SA 4.0.
